Exam Countdown Maker

Build a live countdown to your exam — name it, set the date, and track multiple exams saved in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Type the exam name and pick its date and time.
  2. Press Add exam — a live countdown appears.
  3. Your exams are saved automatically in this browser.
  4. Delete an exam with the ✕ button when done.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are my exams saved?

Your exams are saved in this browser's localStorage, so they are still here when you come back. They don't sync between devices.

Which exam shows the big countdown?

The biggest countdown at the top always shows your nearest upcoming exam. Past exams are marked as done.

Can I track multiple exams?

Yes — add as many as you like; each gets its own live days/hours/minutes/seconds countdown.
